desc: The graphics guard's texture ceiling (port/gfx_guard.h, GitHub #39) brought down to 8 MB ($TTYD_GFX_GUARD_TEXTURE_MB): in Rogueport's harbour the textures alive pass it, the guard says so once and flushes Aurora's texture caches (at most every 5 s), and the game goes on drawing them again: the harbour plays to Mario's control and up the pier
log_must: ^\[gfx\] guard: MB of textures alive \d+, over 8 \(frame \d+\): Aurora's texture cache flushed
